selection_rule: First future full quarter-hour starting >=30s after completed exact-source/startup/health/account root verification, with bounds frozen before start.

slot.requested_interval: start through start+330, retrieval after endpoint

final.requested_interval: start through end+120, retrieval after endpoint

query_scope: Exact new deployment c64e8199-4ce2-4234-ac53-63905e22231d; save each exact request/result and before/after tool clocks. No other live source release during fixed capture.
overlap: Slot/final overlap is intentional; parserdedups original(timestamp,message) retaining each queryfile provenance. Never sums wholelearnercall counterdeltas perwindow.
primary: Actual diagnostic disposition and identity-qualified samewindow/sameat/reason original learnerreceipt; sourcehash/fingerprint/protocol/observeonly/mode flags all required.
secondary: Existing automatic real fills/settlement/status if available; not a strategy trial or profitability proof. Non-target window observations excluded from per-window totals.
failures: Any capped/errored/missing/malformed read remains explicitunknown. Do notextend interval or substituteanotherwindow to rescue result. First unhealthy startup status is not fresh readiness.
